hook: Your selfie preview shows your face backwards.
title: Your Selfie Preview Is Backwards
description:
Hold a shirt with words on it up to your front camera. The preview shows the text reversed, and the saved photo shows it normally. Try it on any phone. Part of the Phone Tests series.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #TechFacts
comment_prompt: Was your text reversed in the preview? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your selfie preview shows your face backwards.
scenes.headline: SELFIE PREVIEW

scenes.narration: Hold up a shirt with words.
scenes.headline: TEXT ON SHIRT

scenes.narration: Tap the shutter and look again.
scenes.headline: TAP THE SHUTTER

scenes.narration: The saved photo flips them back to normal.
scenes.headline: PHOTO IS NORMAL

scenes.narration: Your phone mirrors the preview on purpose.
scenes.headline: MIRRORED ON PURPOSE

scenes.narration: That way it feels like a mirror.
scenes.headline: FEELS LIKE A MIRROR

scenes.narration: But the photo shows how others see you.
scenes.headline: HOW OTHERS SEE YOU

scenes.narration: So your preview is never your real face.
scenes.headline: NOT YOUR REAL FACE

scenes.narration: Next: a mountain painted by minerals.
scenes.headline: NEXT: REAL RAINBOW
